TM2020 input extraction is now supported, and organizers can create TM2020 events with uploaded maps, dates, custom fields, and collaboration rules.

Breaking any of these rules will result in disqualification:
- Replay must finish the race
- No noseboost or uberbugs. A nosebug is considered a noseboost at or above 390 speed, regardless of whether or not it generates additional speed.
- NO sharing of any kind of information about your TAS, including theorycrafting, is allowed.

Very slow or troll submissions may not appear in the results video.

It's time for the first ever Super Intelligence Tool-Assisted Speedrun (SITAS) competition, to establish where we are as a community, and what SITAS means for us.

The track to TAS will be Bonus A-8, the original ESWC version (https://nations.tm-exchange.com/trackshow/681004).

The suggested base for this is to connect the SI of your choice to the ForeverTAS MCP: https://github.com/thirkle/ForeverTAS-MCP. If you or your Super Intelligence don't like this MCP then feel free to construct a better one.

The start date is now. The end time is 11:00 UTC on 11th November (lest we forget).

Rules
No inputs/replays from the map itself (or the TMN variant). Videos can be provided (e.g. https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=jQjA3xVyBhI, https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=53dzAJAb2vA)
No part of the run may be constructed by a human. 
	Humans must not drive any part of the run, edit any inputs, or bruteforce.
	Humans may provide guidance, instructions, suggestions to the SI on how to drive/bruteforce.
You may use whichever SI that you wish, but please disclose which SI you used when submitting.
You may use whichever workflow you desire (i.e. agent swarms).
You may collaborate with other humans to discuss workflows, strategies etc.
The SI may take as many attempts as it needs, learning from each one.

Rules for Team Human
If you don't like the idea of SITAS, then you may also join the competition on the side of Team Human. For Team Human, the rules are inverted; you may not use SI to construct any part of your TAS. You may also collaborate.
